contest.exchange-itu-zone-and: Exchange ITU zone and society abbreviation.
contest.common-exchanges-signal-report: Common exchanges: signal report + serial / zone / age; follow the contest rules.
contest.only-qsos-with-dxcc: Only QSOs with DXCC entities count.
contest.10-m-band-only-exchange: 10 m band only; exchange state / province / serial.
contest.russian-dx-contest-send: Russian DX contest; send a serial, the other station sends a CQ zone.
contest.full-year-contest-calendar: Full-year contest calendar (sorted by next edition)
contest.major-global-contests-add: Major global contests · add countdown reminders

contest.the-world-s-biggest-ssb: The world's biggest SSB contest; exchange CQ zone and serial.

contest.get-ready-and-remember: Get ready and remember to submit your Cabrillo log.
contest.submit-your-log-promptly: Submit your log promptly after a contest (usually Cabrillo) so others can confirm the contacts.
contest.press-enter-or-space: Press Enter or Space in the callsign box to jump to the exchange, then Enter to log; Esc clears. Time is filled with the current UTC; the default report is 599 / 59.
contest.new-session-started-earlier: New session started; earlier QSOs stay in the QSO log
contest.scored-by-the-number: Scored by the number of different callsign prefixes; exchange serial.
contest.dates-are-utc-start: Dates are UTC start times estimated from the usual rules; check the organiser's announcement. Add reminder writes the start time into your countdowns and notifies you via the browser when it arrives.
contest.dates-are-estimated-from: Dates are estimated from the usual 2026 season rules (UTC); check the organiser's announcement.
contest.ssb-leg-of-japan-international-d: The SSB leg of Japan International DX.
contest.japan-international-dx-work: Japan International DX; work JA stations, multipliers by JA prefecture.
contest.ssb-leg-of-european-dx: The SSB leg of the European DX contest.
contest.european-dx-contest-supports: European DX contest; supports QTC traffic.
contest.in-contests-test-means: In contests TEST means contest; call with CQ CONTEST or CQ TEST.
contest.contests-often-use-cq: Contests often use CQ TEST; check the other station's listening frequency (e.g. UP 5) before calling.
contest.contest-qsos-are-also: Contest QSOs are also saved in the QSO log (with CONTEST_ID and exchange, written out on ADIF export). Scores are simplified from a Chinese station's viewpoint and are indicative only — the organiser's checking is final.
contest.stations-outside-the-us: Stations outside the US score only QSOs with DXCC entities.
contest.after-the-contest-log: After the contest, log contacts quickly in Contest logging and export a Cabrillo log in one click.
contest.station-callsign-not-set: Station callsign not set — scoring and Cabrillo need it. Go to

contest.dupe-already-worked-on: Dupe: already worked on this band
contest.24-hour-field-emergency-north-am: 24-hour field / emergency operation; North America's biggest event.
contest.fast-keyboard-entry-live: Fast keyboard entry · live dupe check · self-reported score · export Cabrillo
contest.analysis-empty: No valid QSOs yet. Once you log a few, the rate, idle stretches and multiplier gaps appear here.

contest.analysis-untimed.one: {} QSO has an unreadable date or time, so it is left out of the rate and idle statistics (it still counts toward multipliers).
contest.analysis-untimed.other: {} QSOs have an unreadable date or time, so they are left out of the rate and idle statistics (they still count toward multipliers).

contest.analysis-best-hour.one: Best 60 minutes in a row: {} QSO (starting {} UTC)
contest.analysis-best-hour.other: Best 60 minutes in a row: {} QSOs (starting {} UTC)

contest.analysis-idle-note: The gap between two consecutive QSOs. It is not necessarily rest: the band may simply have been closed, or you were doing something else.
contest.analysis-idle-none: No idle stretch of {} or more.
contest.analysis-no-universe: This contest's multipliers are not counted per band (WPX prefixes, for example), so there is no "fill it in on another band" gap.
contest.analysis-caveat: Gaps are listed only against the bands you have already used; it does not mean the station is audible on that band right now.
contest.analysis-one-band: You have used only one band so far, so there is nothing to compare across bands yet.
contest.analysis-cross-complete: Every multiplier you have worked is already covered on every band you have used.
contest.analysis-cross-band: Multipliers worked on some bands but not yet on others (fewest missing first)
contest.analysis-zones: CQ zones still missing per band

contest.cabrillo-dupes.other: {} QSOs are already in the log and were skipped

contest.cabrillo-x-qso.one: {} QSO marked X-QSO (not counted in the logging software) was ignored
contest.cabrillo-x-qso.other: {} QSOs marked X-QSO (not counted in the logging software) were ignored

contest.cabrillo-switched: Switched to "{}"; the session start was moved to {} UTC so the imported QSOs show up in the list and analysis below.
contest.cabrillo-assumed: The contest "{}" has no built-in template: lines were read as the common "report + one exchange" layout, so please check a few. The QSOs are in the logbook (see the QSO log); the contest page only shows contests that have a template.

contest.cabrillo-skipped.one: {} line could not be read and was not imported:
contest.cabrillo-skipped.other: {} lines could not be read and were not imported:

contest.cabrillo-reason-layout: Column count is not a layout I recognise (multi-field exchanges are not supported)
contest.cabrillo-reason-frequency: Frequency is neither a whole number of kHz nor a band designator
contest.cabrillo-reason-mode: Mode is not CW / PH / FM / RY / DG
contest.cabrillo-reason-date: Date is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD
contest.cabrillo-reason-time: Time is not a valid HHMM
contest.cabrillo-not-cabrillo: No Cabrillo content found (START-OF-LOG or QSO: lines); this does not look like a Cabrillo log.
contest.cabrillo-too-large: The file is over {} MB, which is not like a Cabrillo log; nothing was imported.
contest.cabrillo-limits: Only the "one exchange field per side" layout is read. Cabrillo modes are just CW / phone / FM / RTTY / digital, so finer detail such as FT8 or USB cannot be recovered; the transmitter number is not kept.

contest.scp-not-in-list: {} is not in the candidate list
contest.scp-similar: Callsigns one character away ({} in all):

contest.scp-skipped-lines.other: {} lines that do not look like callsigns were skipped

contest.scp-save-failed: Could not save it to browser storage: it works for now, but you will need to load it again after a refresh.
contest.scp-cleared: The loaded SCP file was cleared

contest.scp-from-log.one: From your QSO log: {} distinct callsign
contest.scp-from-log.other: From your QSO log: {} distinct callsigns

contest.scp-from-file.other: From the loaded SCP file: {} callsigns (release {})

contest.scp-no-file: No SCP file is loaded yet, so only your own QSO log is used for candidates.
contest.scp-note: This site ships no SCP data: the official Super Check Partial site's footer says all rights are reserved and there is no licence to redistribute it. Download it yourself from the official site (master.scp for international contests, masterdx.scp for ARRL DX, masterss.scp for Sweepstakes) and load it here. The file stays in this device's browser only: it is not uploaded and not included in backups. Candidates are in alphabetical order, not by how often a call appears (an .scp file has no such information), and contest categories are not distinguished.
contest.scp-error-empty: No callsigns were found in the file, so it does not look like an SCP file; nothing was loaded.
contest.scp-error-mostly: Most lines in the file do not look like callsigns, so it is probably the wrong file; nothing was loaded.
contest.scp-error-too-large: The file is too large (over {} MB or {} lines), so it does not look like an SCP file; nothing was loaded.
contest.scp-clear-failed: Could not delete the SCP file from storage. Please try again.
contest.cabrillo-split-session: The records were imported, but multiple stations or a long time span require separate contest sessions. The current session was not changed.
contest.session-history-closed: This historical session cannot accept current contacts. Start a new session first.
